projects.name: CineHub
projects.resume: Full-Stack SPA platform for movie discovery. Built with a robust React architecture and integrated RESTful API (Node.js/Express). Features secure JWT authentication, complex state management, and real-time geolocation for cinema finding. Responsive and optimized UI/UX design.

projects.name: ConoXchange
projects.resume: Peer-to-Peer skill exchange marketplace. Developed with MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture using Handlebars and Node.js. Features complete secure authentication system (Bcrypt), session management, and protected CRUD operations. MongoDB database modeled for complex relationships between users and events.

projects.name: Peru Inkas Travel
projects.resume: High-performance corporate landing page for the tourism sector. Optimized for SEO and load speed using Tailwind CSS. Dynamic integration with Google Maps API for route visualization and Mobile-First responsive design.
